feature: Experimental default-off event ledger for non-aggregate temporal-reasoning answers. The prototype was not committed and is not part of the adapter's default path.
base_adapter_commit: d1b2d70 feat: add opt-in cross-session fact ledger verifier
design_commit: 7c95a6b docs: plan temporal event ledger verifier
retrieval_source: Stage302 saved Top-200 candidate sets with exactly the same selected Top-20 order; no reranker call.
decision: Reject and discard the temporal event-ledger code. Neither pilot produced a judge-accepted answer revision from the ledger. The first run's four PASS answers came while the ledger abstained or rejected its result. After relative-time handling was relaxed only for directly cited relative phrases, the only ledger revision still failed the judge. Do not proceed to the 78-row or 500-row temporal-ledger evaluation.
limitations: Both are 14-row pilots with fresh answer generation, not full benchmark runs. The best observed full score remains Stage299 at 461/500 (92.2%), 24 below 485. Stage166 stochastic token reservation was not exercised; memory precision remains unmeasured and live offsite disaster-recovery restore is unverified.
